root_idea.summary: The root's central idea is gathering things together and bringing them within a unified whole.
root_idea.development: From gathering, the lexical field extends to acquiring or possessing, enclosing and containing, coiling or assuming a rounded form, gathered encampments, coiled intestines, and material wound around a camel's hump.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic adjective أَحْوَى has a distinct attested lexical use.
The Quranic plural حَوَايَا is displayed under the supported singular dictionary citation form حَوِيَّةٌ.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description, it characterizes vegetation after it has become dark, dry residue.
The Quranic form is the plural حَوَايَا, used for the intestinal organs among the parts being discussed.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gather, collect, draw, or bring something together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form I verb; the object may be gathered into a whole.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grasp, obtain, acquire, or possess something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Covers gaining possession and holding something within one's grasp or possession.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a place or container, to comprise, encompass, or contain something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a location or receptacle that holds something within it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To turn something around, make it revolve, or wind it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use describing circular movement or winding.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a riding vehicle or saddle called a حَوِيَّةٌ.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The recorded conventional use describes making it for a woman to ride.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The act or state of drawing together, contracting, or being contracted.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form II verbal noun describing contraction or drawing oneself into a smaller compass.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To gather oneself together, coil oneself, or assume a round or circular form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used especially of a serpent and, by comparison, of the intestines.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make a small watering trough or tank for camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form VIII use concerning a camel's water receptacle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Roundness, circularity, or a coiled form.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Said of things such as a serpent or formations of stars; the examples illustrate the form rather than restrict the meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or bodily cavity that contains something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The belly or womb containing a fetus is given as an example of such a container.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A close collection or encampment of tents, especially the tents of a people gathered at a water source.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Regional descriptions include a small group of tents collected together in a productive tract.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A desert tent made of goat hair or camel fur.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a separate nominal use from حِوَاءٌ meaning a collection or place of tents.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Possessing something after earning it or becoming entitled to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of possession grounded in deserving or entitlement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small watering trough or tank made for a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized object noun; it is also associated with the verb meaning to make such a receptacle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A winding, circling, or coiled gut or intestine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term is applied to intestinal coils in an animal's belly, with several technical identifications recorded.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hollow, excavation, well, or rock-and-earth construction that collects and retains rainwater.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Regional explanations differ: the term may denote rain-filled hollows, torrent-retaining wells, or a hard rock surface enclosed so that water gathers in it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloth or pad wound around a camel's hump as a riding seat or saddle; also a riding apparatus prepared for a woman.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The camel-specific saddle covering is distinguished from a similar item used for other animals; reported usage also includes men riding such equipment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who collects or keeps serpents; by later use, a snake-charmer or performer with serpents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The related active-participial form حَاوٍ is also recorded for a serpent keeper.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The constellations Serpentarius and Serpens.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical designation derived from the serpent-keeper sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land abounding in or containing serpents.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive feminine noun used of a tract of land.
